resources.name: Standard elastic constants for fcc nickel

access.notes: Use Young's modulus E_Y = 200 GPa and Poisson's ratio ν = 0.31. These are standard handbook values.

resources.name: Born-Mayer potential parameters for He–He interaction (Gaydaenko & Nikulin, 1970)

access.notes: Potential form V(r) = A exp(−α r). Use parameters A = 0.003736 eV and α = 3.083 Å⁻¹. These are standard literature values.
